_doc: Hue offsets in degrees from the primary hue for the secondary and tertiary families. chroma_mul scales their chroma against the primary. Pop harmonies are for foreground accents (hue contrast); close harmonies are for calm (hue similarity).

mono.describe: one hue family, varied by lightness

analogous-wide.describe: wider neighbours, more colour without clash

split.describe: two hues either side of the opposite

pop-on-calm.describe: a quiet pair plus one loud contrast accent

earth-and-spark.describe: grounded neighbours and one bright spark
